50/G.goal: Explain how a realistic walking-behavior model for system-controlled VR navigation is derived from empirical walking studies, modeled to produce slow-in-slow-out visual speed, and validated for realism and user preference while recognizing its limits for cybersickness.
50/G.achieves: It gives the learner a foundation for optimizing VR navigation as part of building XR systems and prepares the learner to address cybersickness minimization in the course.

50/O1.goal: Explain how a realistic walking-behavior model for system-controlled VR navigation is developed and validated from empirical walking studies.
50/O1.achieves: It lets the learner understand how to make system-controlled VR navigation feel more natural and supports later optimization work on user experience and cybersickness.
